lines.text: Peter writes his second letter, warning that in the last days scoffers will ask where the promise of His coming is.
The world of that time perished in an earthquake, and the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire.
With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and the Day of the Lord will come like a thief.
Believers look forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells, and should be found watchful and blameless.
Peter says the Lord's patience brings salvation, as Paul also wrote, and tells believers to grow in grace and knowledge.
